text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — automated mitigation engaged for traffic anomaly in eu-central (economy tier). Clipper routing policy applied.

oncall-jamie: Saw the alert, i'm on it. P99 spike started ~2:45UTC, economy lanes only.

oncall-maya: confirming, metrics show token ingestion up 3x for economy in eu-central. latency up and some 429s.

eng-rt: any customer-facing errors? Prod dashboard shows rising 429 rate for economy; dedicated and standard unaffected.

emily-cs: got a ticket from AcmeCorp — intermittent failures while using embeddings. they lost 3 requests. flagged high priority.

prod-sam: tagging: possible cause = background batch jobs ramping or a misrouted traffic shard. check recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Recent deploys: no runtime changes in routing service in last 12h. Canary to routing-proxy was 36h ago.

infra-bot: Quick snapshot of routing weights in eu-central: economy=0.45, standard=0.40, priority=0.15. Clipper policy reduced economy to 0.2 at 2726371820.

oncall-jamie: i'm going to do a surgical downweight of economy + bump per-customer soft quota in eu for paying customers. want to avoid mass disable.

eng-rt: agree. steps i suggest: 1) reduce economy weight to 10% in eu-central 2) increase per-customer soft quota for priority customers by 2x 3) enable aggressive prefix/KV cache for economy requests to reduce token regen.

oncall-maya: executing weight change now via admin. command: 
```
infractl routing set-weight --region eu-central --policy clipper --lane economy --weight 0.10
```

oncall-maya: weight change complete. infra-bot shows new weights: economy=0.10, standard=0.60, priority=0.30.

oncall-jamie: applying temporary quota bump for tenants with enterprise tag. curl snippet: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/tenants/quotas/bulk -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"region":"eu-central","selector":"tag:enterprise","soft_quota_multiplier":2.0}'
```

deploy-bot: Cache priming job queued for economy lane in eu-central (job id: cp-9982).

eng-rt: monitoring 1m windows. initial improvement — 429s dropped 60% in first 60s, p99 latency down ~250ms.

emily-cs: AcmeCorp notes errors reduced after ~2 min, they're seeing improved success. i'll update ticket.

prod-sam: what's the plan if we still see sustained throughput after these mitigations?

oncall-jamie: next steps: if anomaly persists we escalate to temporary economy disable in eu (kill economy lanes for 10m and redirect to standard). also prepare rollback of the clipper policy.

eng-rt: file to patch routing policy to add longer tail backpressure: add per-tenant circuit breaker for >80% of soft_quota, and dynamically reduce requests above that by 30%. config snippet: 
```json
{
  "policy": "clipper",
  "region": "eu-central",
  "per_tenant_circuit": {
    "enabled": true,
    "threshold_pct": 80,
    "reduce_pct": 30
  }
}
```

oncall-maya: submitted patch to staging for the policy change. will hold on prod until we confirm persistent activity.

infra-bot: Note: billing/quotas are tracked separately; quota bump applied to enterprise tenants only. economy public/free tier remains capped.

oncall-jamie: quick customer impact note for postmortem: small number of free-tier users saw increased latency and 429s for ~3-8 minutes before mitigation. enterprise tenants had transient failures but the soft-quota bump limited impact.

emily-cs: will reach out to AcmeCorp and offer credits if they want. logging indicates 3 failed requests at 2:46UTC.

eng-rt: trending: traffic back to baseline after weight change + cache priming. will keep clipper policy at reduced weight for 15m then gradually restore if stable.

oncall-maya: scheduling canary restore: 
```
infractl routing set-weight --region eu-central --policy clipper --lane economy --weight 0.30 --gradual 10m
```

oncall-jamie: nice work. marking pager as acknowledged and monitoring for 30m before closing. adding note to ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall-jamie. Severity: S3 -> mitigated. Actions: clipper weight reduce, enterprise quota bump, cache priming.

emily-cs: i'll draft a proactive customer comms for impacted enterprise customers.

prod-sam: add a follow-up to review why economy lane saw the spike — suspect a misconfigured client job or abusive backfill. create postmortem if >1000 429s or >1 enterprise customer impacted.

oncall-jamie: will collect logs and create incident doc. closing thread once metrics are green for 30m.

eng-rt: final check-in at 2726372240: metrics stable, p99 back to normal. recommend post-incident review tomorrow.

oncall-maya: closing monitoring window.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Auto-close in 24h unless reopened.
